texts.facts: 1. Vide this order, I shall dispose of petition U/Sec.9 of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (hereinafter referred to as 'said Act'). 2. Briefly stated, petitioner is a company engaged in rendering services of Food Business Operator, engaged in the business of manufacturing, processing, distribution, sale of food. Respondent no.1 is also engaged in the business of owning and operating an online market place located at URL www.snapdeal.com, the mobile website located at m.snapdeal.command mobile application under the name & style of 'Snapdeal' which acts as an online/ electronic platform for seller and buyer. Respondent no.2 is also an agency engaged in the business of providing technology and M/S. Deviram Restaurants Private ... vs Jasper Infotech Pvt. Ltd on 3 June, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149493106/ 1 management of food business operators for providing tech enabled food solutions to both business operators and consumers. 3. It is further averred that petitioner entered into an agreement with respondents which was tripartite agreement in nature on 01.02.2019. However, by inadvertent oversight, the date of 01.02.2018 was written therein (the M/s. Deviram Restaurants Private Limited Vs. Jasper Infotech Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. agreement). The aforesaid agreement was entered and executed between the parties interalia for outsourcing the management of food business operator by respondent no.1 to respondent no.2 and subsequently to the petitioner by respondent no.2 who was liable to make all the payments for sale of food for which respondent no.2 had collected from the consumers, including daily management requirement and fulfilling the requirement for providing various varieties of food, display of available and upcoming food items in the premises and through app of respondent no.2, on behalf of the petitioner. 4. It is further averred that the said agreement is valid for three years from the date of execution and in terms of clause 4.2 of the agreement, shall remain binding for a period of 12 calendar months (lockin period) commencing from 01.02.2019 to 31.01.2020 unless terminated or determined by either parties in accordance with the terms setout hereunder or expiry by efflux of time as stated in the agreement. 5. It is further averred that in pursuance of the said agreement, petitioner installed a wellequipped kitchen on the modern lines, with state of art M/s. Deviram Restaurants Private Limited Vs. Jasper Infotech Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. apparatus and skilled manpower, incurring an initial expenditure in excess of Rs.20 lacs. Petitioner started operating the kitchen in February, 2019 and got multiple five star ratings from the customers on the app of the respondent no.2. 6. 12. Respondent no.2 has also filed reply to the present application.

The said agreement could not be terminated within the period of one year. 7. Petitioner further seeks directions of the court to direct the respondents not to forcibly dispossess the petitioner from the said address as mentioned above. 9. Counsel for respondent in support of his arguments has also drawn the attention of the court on several complaints regarding inferior food quality of the petitioner, which are stated to be before filing of the present suit.
